Sara — thanks for sending over the docs, appreciate the fast turnaround. A few asks from our side to make sure finance can set up Orchid correctly: 

1) Please confirm the legal entity exactly as it should appear in the vendor record (e.g., Orchid Logistics LLC).
2) Legal address and remit-to address (if different).
3) Federal Tax ID / EIN (please confirm format: XX-XXXXXXX).
4) Bank details for ACH: bank name, routing number, account number, account type (checking/savings), beneficiary name exactly as on the account.
5) For international/wire transfers, provide SWIFT/BIC.
6) Preferred invoice email for Redwood to send invoices and whether Redwood PO numbers are required on invoices.
7) If available, a scanned voided check or bank letter — our finance team typically requires one of those plus the bank authorization form (we can accept a notary'd bank letter or an uploaded PDF from the bank portal).

I've attached a short vendor intake template and a link to our buyer intake form to speed things up: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aXbVendorIntakeTemplate (please use the template if it’s easier). Once we have the items above, I'll open the vendor request and loop in Neha from FinOps to validate and create the vendor code.

Also, note our standard payment terms are Net 30 unless otherwise negotiated; let me know if Orchid requires different terms.

Attachments: [Vendor_Intake_Template.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)]

Best,

Thanks Ben / Sara — received and reviewed. Quick notes from FinOps: 

- W-9: EIN provided (12-3456789) is formatted correctly and matches the name on the W-9.
- Bank docs: the bank authorization form plus the scanned voided check are acceptable for ACH setup. We prefer a bank letter for very large initial payments but for typical onboarding this is sufficient.
- Remit-to: PO Box 77023 will be configured as remit address on the vendor record; legal address will be stored under 'Tax Address.'
- Payment terms: I'll create the vendor with Net 30 and ACH as the primary payment method; wire will be added as alternate.

Next steps: I'll open the vendor request in our ERP now and aim to complete setup within 2 business days. I'll reply with the vendor code (VND-2027-0194) and the ERP request number when complete. After that Ben, please create the initial PO(s) or confirm that your team will route the first invoices for PO-less approval as discussed.
